text.offer: Jonas D'Accor says, "Lords think they own the land because they plant flags on it. Fine. Win a battle with my people, then plant one of ours."
text.progress: The lieges' battles are called across the realm every few hours. Wear your soldier's shield and join one for Jonas; then claim a flagpole next to land he holds, with his flag from the tavern.
text.complete: Jonas D'Accor says, "Ha! Look at that flag fly. The lords are going to hate this."
